# Contacts Cleaner

> Contacts Cleaner is a mobile app and companion website for cleaning up phone contacts on iPhone and Android. It focuses on duplicate detection, junk contact removal, phone number formatting, WhatsApp-related contact analysis, and contact-management support content.

## Product Summary

Contacts Cleaner positions itself as an AI-powered contacts cleanup tool for iPhone and Android.

Primary product themes:

- Find and merge duplicate contacts, including near-duplicates.
- Remove junk or incomplete contacts.
- Standardize phone number formatting.
- Detect WhatsApp-related contact patterns.
- Support cross-account cleanup across common account sources.
- Preserve recoverability with backup and undo flows.

App store references:

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758563652
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ogabassey.contactscleaner

Primary public site pages:

- Homepage: https://contactscleaner.tech/

## Support Summary

Support page: https://contactscleaner.tech/support
Markdown mirror: https://contactscleaner.tech/support.md

Public support guidance currently emphasizes:

- Duplicate detection uses fuzzy matching across names, phone numbers, and emails.
- Potential matches above an 82% similarity score are flagged for review.
- Contact data is processed locally on-device.
- Merge and delete actions create snapshots.
- Undo is available through in-app history.

Support contact:

- support@contactscleaner.tech

## Privacy Summary

Privacy page: https://contactscleaner.tech/privacy
Markdown mirror: https://contactscleaner.tech/privacy.md

Key privacy points described on the public site:

- Contacts Cleaner treats privacy as a core product commitment.
- Contact access is requested to identify duplicates, incomplete entries, and related cleanup issues.
- Some technical device information may be collected for app performance and support.
- Contact data is described as being processed locally on-device.
- Full contact lists are not uploaded unless a user explicitly uses a backup-related feature.
- Users are told they can revoke contact permissions in device settings.
- Privacy contact is provided for policy questions.

Privacy contact:

- privacy@contactscleaner.tech
